description: Use this when asking 'What size water softener might fit my household and tested water hardness?' or 'Can you estimate yearly salt costs from my household's water use?'. Gallons per person per day is required (no national default used), for softened water only. Iron is optional; unknown when absent, and changes the setting per EcoPure's clear-water ferrous iron rule (5 gpg per ppm); other makers differ. Returns grains per day, working capacity before reserve, optional paired model ratings, three idealized EP42 test-rating examples, notes, assumptions and dated primary sources. Costs are salt only. Pure Decimal arithmetic, no network or model. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

bag_price.description: Price per bag; one store's price (Fleet Farm, observed 2 Oct 2026); enter yours.

capacity_grains.description: Your manual's grains per regeneration; requires salt_lb.

gallons_per_person_day.description: Required softened gallons per person per day; no national default used. Exclude bypassing outdoor taps.

hardness.description: Required measured hardness; after conversion 0 < gpg <= 100.

hardness_unit.description: gpg or mg/L; divide mg/L by 17.1 (W1).

iron_ppm.description: Optional dissolved clear-water ferrous iron in ppm; absent means unknown. EcoPure adds 5 gpg per ppm (W4); other makers differ.

salt_lb.description: Your manual's lb salt at capacity_grains; requires capacity_grains.
